card.name: Citation and web address pieces
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside journal citations and URLs, such as the year, month, period or slash after a journal name. Also fires on 'of' after 'overdosage' in a label heading.

modes.label: Reference lines
modes.description: Punctuation, dates or journal words inside a literature citation.
modes.example: Psychiatric characteristics in a self-selected sample of boys with Klinefelter syndrome. Pediatrics<<.>> 2009 May;1

modes.label: Web addresses
modes.description: Slash or digit pieces inside a URL path.

modes.label: Overdosage heading
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'acute overdosage' in a label section.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE Signs and Symptoms Toxic effects accompanying acute overdosage<< of>> clomiphene citrate have not

card.writes: The promoted words are odd adverbs and non-standard forms, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the small pieces of reference citations and web links, like dates and slashes.
